description: Real-time last-minute tour and activity inventory. Search available slots across Iceland, Italy, Morocco, Portugal, Japan, Tanzania, Finland, Montenegro, Romania, and more � then book instantly via Stripe. Powered by the OCTO open booking standard via Bokun. Suppliers: Arctic Adventures (Iceland glacier hikes, ice caves, snowmobiling, aurora, diving, whale watching), Arctic Sea Tours (North Iceland whale watching), Bicycle Roma (Rome e-bike tours, food tours, day trips), Pure Morocco Experience (Sahara desert tours, Marrakech experiences), Ramen Factory Kyoto (cooking classes, workshops), O Turista Tours (Lisbon, Porto, Sintra day trips and transfers), Hillborn Experiences (ultra-luxury Tanzania safaris, Kilimanjaro climbs, Zanzibar retreats).

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: DoS Resilience — Missing Rate Limit / Timeout
findings.description: tool performs network or execution operations but declares no rate-limit, timeout, or retry configuration
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.
